test_Series_item: test the Series.item method returns Python scalars instead of numpy scalars for single-element Series
test_Series_item_float: test the Series.item method returns Python float for a single-element float Series
test_Series_item_multi_value_error: test that Series.item raises ValueError when called on a multi-element Series
test_Series_item_timestamp: test that Series.item returns a Timestamp for a single-element datetime Series
test_Series_item_timedelta: test that Series.item returns a Timedelta for a single-element timedelta Series
